description: Support for the Cesium programming language: syntax highlighting, comments, brackets and indentation for .csm and .csi files, and errors from the bootstrap compilers
configuration.title: Cesium
config.cesium.server.path.markdownDescri: The language server to run. Empty: the one bundled with the extension, else `zcsls` on the `PATH`. A relative path is taken relative to the first workspace folder; `~` is the home directory.
config.cesium.compiler.path.markdownDesc: The bootstrap compiler the language server checks units with: `cesium1` or `cesium0`, or a directory that holds one. Empty: `cesium1`, else `cesium0`, on the `PATH`. A name starting with `cesium0` is run as `cesium0`.
config.cesium.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and the language server in its output channel.
command.cesium.restartServer.title: Restart Language Server
